title: Valuables Floater Condition: Newly Acquired Items
content:
Policy service training notes, Larkspur Valuables Floater: newly acquired items.

**The condition.** A newly acquired item of a class already scheduled is covered automatically from its acquisition date up to the tier's automatic-coverage percentage of that class's total (never above the tier's cap per class) when it is reported within the tier's reporting window, and its premium is then charged from the acquisition date; reported later, it is covered and charged only from the report date.

**What "that class's total" means.** For the class the new item belongs to, the total is the scheduled values added to the floater in that class, plus the increases recorded on revaluation in that class, less the values removed from that class, as they stand on the date in question.

## Questions and answers

**Q. From when is a new item covered if it is reported inside the window?**
From its acquisition date, up to the automatic amount for its class.

**Q. From when is its premium charged in that case?**
Also from the acquisition date.

**Q. And if it is reported after the window has closed?**
It is covered, and its premium charged, only from the report date.

**Q. Which items does the condition speak to?**
A newly acquired item of a class already scheduled on the floater.

**Q. How is the automatic amount found?**
It is the tier's percentage of the class's total, and it is never above the tier's cap per class.

## Worked case (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical Valuables Floater Prestige whose watches class stands at 40000 USD. The Prestige automatic coverage is 30 percent, capped at 100000 USD per class, with a 60-day reporting window.

| Step of reasoning | Result |
|---|---|
| 30 percent of 40000 USD | 12000 USD |
| Compared with the 100000 USD cap | cap not reached; automatic amount 12000 USD |
| New watch acquired 1 June, reported 20 June (19 days after) | covered from 1 June up to 12000 USD; premium charged from 1 June |
| Same watch reported instead on 15 September (beyond 60 days) | covered and charged only from 15 September |
